events.title: I'm Alive! New Rooms & More
events.summary: Hello everyone!It's been a while since my last update! events.title: Improved Demo
events.summary: After some feedbacks, I've decided to update the demo and make it more enjoyable with :More clues for puzzlesExit Elevator DoorBetter feedback and impact for the battle systemMore brightness to the gameMore monsters early onQuicker IntroBetter UI

events.title: The Demo is Out!
events.summary: Hi everyone!The demo is out, and you can finally try it for yourself.You can give me feedbacks on the community hub or on my discord server for the game :Discord ServerIf you'd like to support the development of my game, you can do so on my Patreon : Mathim Draw Patreon (get access to unreal project and assets of the game).I hope you'll enjoy the demo!Honestly I wanted to publish the demo for this Steam Fest, but I was too slow :(

events.title: Development Update
events.summary: Hello everyone!The demo release is going to be slightly delayed. I literally only have TWO more rooms left to create in the game, and then I just need to briefly connect them to the story. After that, the demo will finally be ready!I’m slow with development, but I’ve never been this close to the finish line.Tank ControlsTank control is now fully integrated into the game, and you’ll be able to switch between modern control and tank control! I know this might sound surprising to some of you, there

events.title: About the Game and the Demo
events.summary: Hello to everyone interested in my game!I wanted to give you an update on the development of the game and talk a bit about what I’m currently planning for both now and the future.Demo ProgressCornered Cadavers is my first game on Steam. I’ve been developing it for about a year now, and at the moment I’m mainly improving the level design to create a smoother and less frustrating experience.There are still many things that need improvement, such as the combat animations and some of the cutscenes.
